title: 一张高分辨率的户外全身照
prompt: A high-resolution, full outdoor shot of a young East Asian woman with a radiant smile, captured from the chest up. She stands under bright, direct sunlight, casting strong, defined shadows from the brick building behind her. Her dark, wavy, and voluminous hair is styled with subtle curls, and a pair of white-framed round sunglasses are pushed up onto her head. She has fair, smooth skin, bright, upturned dark eyes, a delicate nose, and a wide, open-mouthed smile revealing her upper teeth. Her lips are a natural, soft pink. She wears a fitted, red scoop-neck tank top that is slightly cropped, revealing a hint of her midriff and navel. A delicate silver chain with a small cross pendant adorns her neck. A black strap from a backpack or shoulder bag is visible over her left shoulder. Her right hand, with slender fingers and light nail polish, holds a vibrant, glossy red spherical object, resembling a cherry or lollipop. The background features a reddish-brown brick building with repetitive architectural columns or pilasters, topped with light-colored caps, creating strong vertical shadows. The setting is a sunny urban sidewalk with light-colored paving. The overall aesthetic is cheerful, vibrant, and natural with a focus on sharp detail and warm lighting.
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro或Nano Banana Pro拍摄高分辨率户外全身照，呈现自然风格，细节清晰、色彩鲜活，非常适合时尚摄影、旅行博客或个人品牌展示。
